rules.gist: Ek single deposit ke baad casino me continue win, aur usi deposit ka 10X jeet liya.
info: 11 - Casino me continue win + SINGLE deposit ka 10X
Casino me koi user continue win hua hai wo user fraud list me aayega Deposit amount se ager 10X win hai to
SINGLE deposit (har deposit alag case). Total deposit NAHI.
Us single deposit ka time. Deposit se PEHLE ka kuch nahi liya.
Agle deposit ka time (taaki jeet sirf ISI deposit ko attribute ho). Aakhri deposit ka window data ke end tak.
Us window me sabse lambi run jisme <=2 haar ho, usme >=10 wins. (window ke andar p90=8, p95=9 -> 10 = outlier)
Usi window me running cumulative NET (jeet - haar) kabhi bhi >= 10 x us single deposit
GROSS me haar ghatati nahi, isliye jo bahut rounds khelta hai uska gross apne aap 10x cross kar jata hai. NET = balance sach me 10 guna hua.
